# Shambhave Wellness Foundation

> Non-profit arm of Shambhave Wellness running community mental health programmes, subsidised therapy and volunteering in India.

Shambhave Wellness Foundation is a registered non-profit organization dedicated to fostering social, emotional, and psychological well-being for senior citizens, women, and underserved communities.

## Key facts

- Location: Orchid Petals, Sector 49, Gurugram, Haryana 122018, India
- Phone: +919315311334
- Email: info@shambhavewellness.org
- Languages: English, Hindi

## Courses and training

- [Astrology, Numerology & PsychoSpiritual Studies | Shambave Wellness](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/course/astrology-numerology-psychospiritual-studies): A transformative 6-month program that decodes the esoteric blueprints of human personality and destiny using cosmic charting and numerical vibrations.
- [Boundary Enhancement Therapy](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/course/boundary-enhancement-therapy): A 6-month professional training program focused on understanding, assessing and strengthening psychological boundaries across personal, emotional, relational, family, workplace and digital settings.
- [Youth, Parenting & Relationship Training | Shambave Wellness](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/course/youth-parenting-relationship-training): A specialized program providing evidence-based frameworks to navigate the complexities of modern child-rearing, screen addiction, and adolescent psychology.
- [Narcissism in Clinical Practice](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/course/narcissism-in-clinical-practice): A 6-month advanced professional training program for mental-health and healthcare professionals focused on understanding, assessing and therapeutically working with narcissistic presentations.
- [Foundational Wellness & Healing Programs | Shambave Wellness](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/course/foundational-wellness-healing-programs): Provides a comprehensive blueprint for holistic well-being, integrating nutrition, somatic practices, sleep hygiene, and stress physiology.
- [Integrative Somatic Trauma Therapy](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/course/integrative-somatic-trauma-therapy): An 11-module clinical training integrating polyvagal theory, somatic experiencing, and neurobiological regulation for psychotherapists and trauma clinicians.
- [Psychodiagnosis Masterclass in Clinical Assessment](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/course/psychodiagnosis-the-masterclass-in-clinical-assessment): Master psychological assessment techniques, diagnostic frameworks, case formulation, and clinical evaluation skills with expert-led training by Shambhave Wellness.
- [Dark Psychology & Behavioral Manipulation Course](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/course/dark-psychology-behavioral-manipulation): Learn the psychology of influence, manipulation tactics, persuasion techniques, and behavioral patterns through advanced psychological study from Shambhave Wellness.
- [Advanced Clinical Study of Personality Disorders](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/course/personality-disorders-advanced-clinical-study): Gain in-depth knowledge of personality disorders, diagnosis, treatment approaches, and clinical case management strategies at Shambhave Wellness.
- [Clinical Hypnotherapy Certification Training Course](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/course/clinical-hypnotherapy-certification): Become a certified hypnotherapist and learn subconscious mind techniques, hypnosis protocols, and therapeutic intervention methods from Shambhave Wellness.
- [Regression Therapy Certification | Inner Child Healing](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/course/regression-therapy-inner-child-past-life): Learn regression therapy techniques for inner child healing, emotional release, past life exploration, and personal transformation from Shambhave Wellness.
- [SEHT Certification | Subconscious Energy Healing](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/course/seht-subconscious-energy-healing-therapy): Master Subconscious Energy Healing Therapy (SEHT) techniques to help clients overcome emotional blocks and achieve holistic wellness at Shambhave Wellness.
- [Advanced Energy Healing & Chakra Science Course](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/course/advanced-energy-healing-chakra-science): Explore chakra systems, energy healing methods, vibrational wellness, and holistic therapeutic practices through advanced training at Shambhave Wellness.
- [Psycho Astro Therapy (PAT) Certification Course](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/course/psycho-astro-therapy-pat-certification): Learn Psycho Astro Therapy techniques at Shambhave Wellness that integrate psychological insights and astrological principles for holistic guidance.

- [Breaking the Stigma Around Therapy:  5 Myths We Need to Stop Believing | Shambave Wellness NGO](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/blog/breaking-the-stigma-around-therapy-5-myths-we-need-to-stop-believing): Break the stigma around therapy by debunking 5 common myths and misconceptions. Discover how therapy can support mental health, emotional well-being, and personal growth.
- [Learning to Say No  - How Therapy Can Support Healthy Boundaries | Shambave Wellness NGO](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/blog/learning-to-say-no-how-therapy-can-support-healthy-boundaries): Learn how therapy can help you say no, set healthy boundaries, build self-confidence, and create healthier relationships with support from Shambave Wellness NGO.
- [How Narcissistic Abuse Affects Memory and Decision-Making  | Shambave Wellness NGO](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/blog/how-narcissistic-abuse-affects-memory-and-decision-making): Learn how narcissistic abuse impacts your brain, emotions, and relationships. Explore symptoms, long-term effects, and practical steps toward healing.
- [Why Mental Health Is Just as Important as Physical Health | Shambave Wellness NGO](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/blog/why-mental-health-is-just-as-important-as-physical-health): Discover why mental health is as important as physical health. Learn how emotional well-being impacts overall health with insights from Shambave Wellness NGO.
- [The 5 Signs to Know You're In A Narcissistic Relationship | Shambave Wellness NGO](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/blog/the-5-signs-to-know-you-re-in-a-narcissistic-relationship): Understand the signs of a narcissistic relationship, its impact on mental health, and practical steps to set boundaries, seek support, and begin healing.
- [How To Teach Children About Healthy Boundaries | Shambave Wellness NGO](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/blog/how-to-teach-children-about-healthy-boundaries): Learn how to teach children about healthy boundaries with practical tips that build self-respect, confidence, emotional safety, and healthy relationships.
- [Healthy Self-Confidence: Building a Positive Relationship with Yourself](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/blog/healthy-self-confidence-building-a-positive-relationship-with-yourself): Build healthy self-confidence with practical tips to improve self-esteem, embrace self-worth, and develop a positive relationship with yourself.
- [How Therapy Helps Build Emotional Resilience | Shambave Wellness NGO](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/blog/how-therapy-helps-build-emotional-resilience): Learn how therapy helps build emotional resilience by improving coping skills, emotional balance, and mental well-being for a healthier, happier life.
- [Anxiety vs Stress: Understanding the Difference and Finding Relief | Shambave Wellness NGO](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/blog/anxiety-vs-stress-understanding-the-difference-and-finding-relief): Learn the difference between stress and anxiety, their symptoms, causes, and effective coping strategies. Discover expert tips for better mental wellness and emotional balance.
- [Healing Childhood Trauma: How Therapy Helps Break Generational Patterns | Shambave Wellness NGO](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/blog/healing-childhood-trauma-how-therapy-helps-break-generational-patterns): Break generational trauma and heal childhood wounds with trauma therapy and family counseling at Shambhave Wellness Foundation. Learn how emotional healing can improve relationships, parenting, and overall well-being for a healthier future.
- [Why Narcissistic Relationships Are So Hard to Leave | Shambave Wellness NGO](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/blog/why-narcissistic-relationships-are-so-hard-to-leave): Discover why narcissistic relationships are so difficult to leave. Learn about emotional manipulation, trauma bonds, and healing strategies with insights from Shambave Wellness NGO.
- [Why Mental Health Support Should Be Accessible to Everyone](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/blog/mental-health-support-accessible-to-everyone): Discover how Shambhave Wellness Foundation is making mental health support accessible through counseling, awareness, and community programs.
- [Healing Minds, Empowering Lives](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/blog/healing-minds-empowering-lives): Learn the inspiring story of Shambhave Wellness Foundation and its mission to heal minds, empower lives, and promote mental wellbeing.
- [Mental Health Is a Right, Not a Privilege](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/blog/mental-health-is-a-right-not-a-privilege): Explore why mental health care should be accessible to all and how communities can support emotional wellbeing and mental wellness.

## Projects

- [Our Social Impact Projects & Initiatives](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/project): Explore our community-driven mental health projects, senior citizen wellness circles, women empowerment workshops, and youth psychological first-aid programs.
- [Community Outreach for Elderly Women Mental Health](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/project/community-outreach-elderly-women-mental-health-suppor): Supporting elderly women through mental health awareness, emotional wellness programs, counseling, and community outreach initiatives.
- [Mental Health Outreach for Senior Women](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/project/mental-health-outreach-for-senior-women): Empowering senior women with mental health support, emotional care, awareness programs, and community-based wellness initiatives.
- [Spreading Smiles Healing Hearts | Wellness Initiative](https://foundation.shambhavewellness.org/project/spreading-smiles-healing-hearts): A compassionate initiative promoting emotional healing, mental wellness, happiness, and community support for vulnerable individuals.
